interview.title: A few quick questions

landing.headline: Find the scholarships you appear eligible for
landing.pitch: Answer a few questions by voice or tap, in your language. Your documents stay encrypted on your own device.
landing.raviNote: Ravi is a sample student with example data.
landing.guideHello: Hello! I am your guide. I help you find scholarships you appear eligible for.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: A few short questions, each one read back to you.
how.step2Body: The schemes you appear eligible for, in one plan.
how.step3Body: Encrypted on your device before anything is stored.

vault.title: Your vault
vault.intro: Documents are encrypted on this device before anything is stored. The server only ever sees scrambled bytes.
vault.sampleNote: The sample is made-up text, not a real document.
vault.passphraseHelp: You will need it to open this document. We cannot recover it, and it never leaves this device.
vault.failed: Could not encrypt this file. Please try again.
vault.stubNote: Prototype vault: AES-256-GCM in your browser
vault.guide: I lock each document on this device before anything is stored. The server only ever sees scrambled bytes.

serverView.title: What the server sees
serverView.serverCaption: The server only ever stores this.
serverView.locked: Locked. Enter your passphrase to read this document here.
serverView.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase did not work. The document stays locked.
serverView.alsoStored: Also stored: a random salt, a wrapped key and a nonce.
serverView.neverStored: Never stored: your passphrase or the readable document.
serverView.noPreview: No preview for this file type. It stays encrypted.
serverView.guide: On the left is your document, readable only here. On the right is everything the server ever holds.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every use of your data is written here. Entries show field names and purposes, never values. Each entry carries the hash of the one before it, so a change anywhere breaks the chain.
audit.okBody: All {count} entries match their hashes. Nothing was changed.
audit.brokenBody: Entry #{idx} no longer matches its hash, so it was changed after it was written. Every entry after it cannot be verified.
audit.afterBreak: Cannot be verified: it comes after a changed entry
audit.demoNote: Demo control: this edits one entry in memory only.
audit.guide: Every use of your data is written down here, as field names only.
audit.guideChecking: Checking each link in the chain.
audit.guideOk: Every link holds. Nothing was changed.
audit.guideBroken: Entry #{idx} was changed after it was written, so the chain breaks there.

voice.listening: I am listening. Say your answer, then press stop.
voice.notUnderstood: I heard “{text}” but could not find the answer in it. Try again, or tap an answer.
voice.denied: I cannot use the microphone. Allow it in your browser, or tap an answer.
voice.failed: Voice did not work just now. Please tap an answer.
